name: accessflow
description: Gestão local de acessos fictícios, com o módulo AccessGuard.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @accessflow/api" "npm run dev -w @accessflow/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @accessflow/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @accessflow/api && npm run typecheck -w @accessflow/web
